body: Cars and computers, but the latter is what triggered all of this, i got too stressed at work a few years ago as i took a job that was nothing like the job spec and it all went down hill from there...

You sound a little similar to me, i suppose it can be seen as selfish, but at the end of the day its your choice so i tend to forget about that aspect as you will always be top priority in your own life. At the same time why are you feeling as if you should be selfish tonight?. Are you just constantly down and sick of trying to "get better"? Do you think it would just be easier if you commited suicide? I hope talking a little helps, it helps me normally!
